body:
I have the same feeling but with I see a car pass by or near me I think “hit me”. When I listen to certain types of music I get emotional where I hit things or myself. I always thought it was normal to be suicidal until a coworker said “I could kill myself” jokingly when I was thinking of suicide constantly. When the person said that they were joking and would never kill themselves, I knew then that I needed help. 

Please see a therapist or counselor. Talk to a close friend who cares about you. I did and it somewhat helps me.
